mentions.name: ColliePWA
mentions.description: A mobile PWA interface for continuing to work with your agents while away from the desktop, meeting developers where they work in terminal multiplexers like tmux and zellij. Remote access can be set up through any front door such as Tailscale, and it doesn't rely on third parties to run.
mentions.audience: Developers who work with agents in desktop terminal multiplexers
mentions.source_excerpt: ColliePWA[1] a mobile interface to continue working with your agents when you're on the. Trying to meet devs where they work on the desktop in multiplexers (herdr/tmux/zellij). Remote access can be set up with any front door like tailscale.
